description: Wait until a condition holds, then return the snapshot: `text` appears, `textGone` disappears, `selector` (CSS) / `ref` becomes visible, `selectorGone` disappears, the URL contains `urlIncludes` (or changes, `urlChanged`), or the network goes idle (`networkIdle`). All given conditions must hold. Fails with a clear error after `timeout` seconds (default 15, max 120).

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12".

name: wait_for
